title: Hosanna to King David's Son
description: Hosanna to King David's Son in Tonic Solfa to MELCOMBE, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book III, prepared for the Lord's Supper, hymn 42, headed “L. M”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Long Metre (8.8.8.8). This page sets the words to MELCOMBE; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Ho-san-na to King Da-vid's Son, Who reigns on a su-pe-rior throne; We bless the Prince of heav-enly birth Who brings sal-va-tion down to earth.

lines: Who reigns on a superior throne;
We bless the Prince of heavenly birth
Who brings salvation down to earth.
Old men and babes in Sion sing
The growing glories of her King.

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to MELCOMBE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
